hero.subtitle: AI RESUME BUILDER
hero.description: Write your experience in simple words or upload an existing resume. AI restructures it and adapts it to your chosen template.
hero.step1_example: "I wrote backend for 2 years in fintech, accelerated payment system"

howItWorks.title: A ready resume in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: From import to download — three steps.

steps.title: Describe yourself
steps.subtitle: Write a few sentences or upload your old resume. Don't worry about format or structure.

steps.title: AI builds the structure
steps.subtitle: Title, summary, experience, skills — everything is sorted into sections. You can edit every item yourself.

steps.title: Choose and download
steps.subtitle: Adjust the template, font, size, and color. See the result instantly and download it as a PDF.

features.title: Everything you need to work on your resume
features.subtitle: Each feature serves one purpose: cutting down the time you spend on the text.

items.title: AI generation
items.subtitle: Builds a complete resume from free-form text, and polishes individual entries in one click.

items.title: Uzbek and English
items.subtitle: Keep two versions in one account: for local and international job listings.

items.title: 6 templates
items.subtitle: From minimal to bold headlines. Your content stays in place when you switch templates.

items.title: Font and color
items.subtitle: Google Fonts catalog, font size, and accent color. Everything updates live.

items.title: Real PDF export
items.subtitle: A PDF with a preserved text layer, generated right in your browser. Downloading is available on the Pro plan.

items.title: ATS-friendly
items.subtitle: Templates are structured so applicant-tracking software can read them, so your experience never gets lost.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no hidden terms
pricing.subtitle: No payment is required to get started. Upgrade to Pro when you need to download, and cancel anytime.
